title: Access and use York VPN
issue: You need to access or request York VPN
resolution_html:
1. Install the York-supported VPN client as directed by your faculty or unit IT team
  2. Open your approved connection profile in Ivanti Secure Access
  3. Sign in with Passport York and complete Duo verification
  4. Disconnect when access to the restricted resource is complete

For an access problem, contact askIT with the service name and relevant error
